evidenceRules: Store commit SHAs, run IDs, deployment IDs, timestamps, status codes, migration names, and sanitized counts.
Never store credentials, tokens, connection strings, raw authorization headers, customer names, phones, emails, comments, IP addresses, or Telegram payloads.
Redact provider host details when they do not help reproduce the check.
Use request IDs only when they cannot be connected to customer data in public artifacts.
Keep runtime screenshots and logs out of Git unless deliberately sanitized and required as durable evidence.
Record failed checks honestly; PASS for this task means the baseline is complete, not that the full project or CI is release-ready.
